title: A mutually-declared enumPolicyDivergence pair — the READER's known-present input
$comment: THIS FIXTURE EXISTS BECAUSE THE CORPUS CAN LEGITIMATELY CONTAIN ZERO OF THESE. On 2026-09-13 the Team Lead narrowed `templateStatus` to `closed` and stripped both markers of the only live mutually-declared pair — a correct ruling that removed the last instance of a category. The live floor asserting `>= 2` declared divergences then fired, and it was RIGHT to: `no exemption is declared` and `the reader has stopped seeing the field` are different facts and produce the identical empty list. This file is what separates them. It is never emitted, never referenced by a contract, and exists only so `enumOccurrences` can be shown to still read `enumPolicyDivergence` off a real file on disk.

enumPolicyDivergence.reason: Response versus request direction — the shape 0041 amendment 1 licenses.

responseStatus.description: The RESPONSE half. `extensible`, because a value added later must not break a client reading it.

enumPolicyDivergence.reason: Request versus response direction — amendment 1 makes a request enum always closed.

requestStatusFilter.description: The REQUEST half. `closed`, because a request enum is always closed.
